params.name: requestor-cid
params.description: CID of the company you are making the request for.

params.name: date-type
params.description: Whether the date range applies to the event date or the posting date.

params.name: start-date
params.description: First date in the query, inclusive. Required if end-date is used.

params.name: end-date
params.description: Last date in the query, exclusive. Required if start-date is used.

params.name: cids
params.description: Comma-separated CIDs of joined advertisers or publishers.

params.name: action-types
params.description: Comma-separated action types: bonus, click, impression, sale, lead, advanced sale, advanced lead, performance incentive.

params.name: commission-id
params.description: Return everything newer than this Commission ID. The documented incremental-polling pattern: send the most recent Commission ID you received and CJ returns all new data since then.

items.docs: DEPRECATED. CJ's documentation states this API "has been deprecated and will be removed on June 1, 2019" and directs integrators to the GraphQL Commission Detail API at https://commissions.api.cj.com/query. The host still answers (HTTP 401 without a token) as of 2026-08-13. Documented call limit: 25 times per minute. Date ranges are 1 day minimum, 31 days maximum; start-date is inclusive and end-date is exclusive.

info.name: Retrieve item-level detail for a commission (deprecated)

params.name: original-action-id
params.description: The identification number used to correlate the original transaction and its corrections.

items.docs: DEPRECATED alongside the commissions resource. Returns item-detail records correlated to an original action id.
